start_size.comment: A value < 0 means random in the range [minSize,maxSize]

adapt_ad_prob.comment: Determines the rate of adaption of adProb. Set to 0, if you do not need this feature

loc_adapt_ad_prob.comment: Determines the rate of adaption of location-adProb. Set to 0, if you do not need this feature

min_ad_prob.comment: The lower allowed boundary for adProb-variation

max_ad_prob.comment: The upper allowed boundary for adProb-variation

loc_min_ad_prob.comment: The lower allowed boundary for loc_adProb-variation

loc_max_ad_prob.comment: The upper allowed boundary for loc_adProb-variation

min_sigma.comment: minSigma must be positive and smaller than maxSigma

max_sigma.comment: maxSigma must be positive and larger than minSigma

loc_min_sigma.comment: loc_minSigma must be positive and smaller than loc_maxSigma

loc_max_sigma.comment: loc_maxSigma must be positive and larger than loc_minSigma

bg_red.comment: Otherwise the allowed value range is [0.,1.]

bg_green.comment: Otherwise the allowed value range is [0.,1.]

bg_blue.comment: Otherwise the allowed value range is [0.,1.]

n_triangles.comment: Capped at 64 to match the kernel's per-thread corner cache (MONALISA_MAXTRI)

alpha_sort.comment: Disabled so streamline order == render order (CPU/GPU parity)

mutate_alpha_channel.comment: Whether the alpha channel shall be mutated

change_bg_color.comment: Whether the background color shall be mutated

eval_policy.comment: 2 (a.k.a. USESIGMOID): Assign a multiple of validity_level_ and sigmoid barrier to invalid solutions, apply a sigmoid function to valid evaluations

steepness.comment: The parameter must have a value > 0.

barrier.comment: The parameter must have a value > 0.

max_unsuccessful_adaptions.comment: The maximum number of unsuccessful adaptions in a row for one call to adapt()

maxmode.comment: Note that minimization is the by far most common option.

use_random_crash.comment: Indicates whether random crashes should occur for debugging purposes

random_crash_prob.comment: The probability of a random crash to occur
